decision.reasoning_trace: During this shopping session, I noticed several items in the 'Backpacks' category were actually camping accessories like cookware, pillows, and tents. I filtered these out to focus on actual carrying gear. Within my consideration set, I compared specialized bags (fishing, baseball, hydration) against general-purpose and hiking packs. The Maxpedition (prod_backpacks_038) was a very high-quality EDC option, but for actual backpacking utility, the High Sierra Pathway 70L (prod_backpacks_068) offered the best value, capacity, and ergonomic support according to its detailed user reviews. Its high rating of 4.7 and internal frame design make it the most suitable choice for serious outdoor use.
